interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor for link state changes (e.g., ['eth0', 'wlan0']).

default_script.description: Global script path to run for *all* interfaces (used when per-interface scripts are omitted).

link_stable_delay.description: Seconds to wait after a link change before considering the link stable and triggering scripts.

script_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a script to finish before sending SIGKILL.
